snippet.title: Megaman X: Omega Blaster (Ultimate Edition) - Trailer (SAGE 2025)
snippet.description:
Megaman X: Omega Blaster (Ultimate Edition) Trailer for SAGE 2025

Finally the saga with the Omega Blaster comes to an end, this will be the last update, in it we will have 4 playable characters X, Zero and two armors with each one presenting a route with a different ending. I hope you like it :)
